department: Materials Science & Engineering Program (College of Science & Mathematics and Henry M. Rowan College of Engineering)

deadline.value: The Materials Science & Engineering Ph.D. page does not state an application deadline.

gre_subject.value: ETS does not offer a GRE Subject Test in Materials Science and Engineering.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: The Materials Science & Engineering Ph.D. page does not state whether pre-admission supervisor approval is required.

funding.value: A limited number of teaching assistantships are available, and applicants may inquire with program coordinators regarding research assistantships.
funding.quote: A limited number of teaching assistantships are available. To inquire about research assistantships, contact program coordinators, Timothy Vaden and Wei Xue, at mse@rowan.edu.

entry_route.value: Students may enter directly from a bachelor's degree (72 credits beyond the bachelor's) or after a master's degree (42 credits beyond the master's).
entry_route.quote: The completion of a minimum of 72 credits of graduate-level work beyond the bachelor’s degree OR a minimum of 42 credits of graduate-level work beyond the master’s degree is required.

notes: Interdisciplinary Ph.D. administered jointly across the College of Science & Mathematics and Henry M. Rowan College of Engineering.
